title: Talking About Goals and Giving Advice
titlePersian: صحبت دربارهٔ هدف‌ها و توصیه کردن
context: People share goals and ask for advice all the time. You need ways to say what you hope to achieve, how far you have got, and to advise others without sounding bossy.
contextPersian: مردم همیشه هدف‌هایشان را به اشتراک می‌گذارند و توصیه می‌خواهند. باید بتوانی بگویی به چه چیزی امید داری، تا کجا پیش رفته‌ای و بدون پرمدعا شدن به دیگران توصیه کنی.

expressions.example: My goal is to pass the IELTS exam this year.
expressions.examplePersian: هدفم این است که امسال در آزمون آیلتس قبول شوم.

expressions.example: I'm hoping to change jobs next year.
expressions.examplePersian: امیدوارم سال بعد کارم را عوض کنم.

expressions.example: I've been working on my pronunciation for six months.
expressions.examplePersian: شش ماه است روی تلفظم کار می‌کنم.
expressions.note: Present perfect continuous: it started in the past and is still going on.

expressions.example: I'm working on my speaking. It's my weakest skill.
expressions.examplePersian: دارم روی صحبت کردنم کار می‌کنم. ضعیف‌ترین مهارتم است.

expressions.english: I want to get better at...
expressions.example: I want to get better at writing emails.
expressions.examplePersian: می‌خواهم در نوشتن ایمیل بهتر شوم.

expressions.example: You should practise a little every day.
expressions.examplePersian: بهتر است هر روز کمی تمرین کنی.

expressions.example: Why don't you join a conversation club?
expressions.examplePersian: چرا به یک باشگاه گفتگو نمی‌پیوندی؟

expressions.example: If I were you, I'd talk to your manager first.
expressions.examplePersian: اگر جای تو بودم، اول با مدیرت صحبت می‌کردم.
expressions.note: If I were (not was) in advice.

expressions.example: I'd recommend starting with short videos.
expressions.examplePersian: پیشنهاد می‌کنم با ویدیوهای کوتاه شروع کنی.

expressions.english: It might be a good idea to...
expressions.example: It might be a good idea to ask for feedback.
expressions.examplePersian: شاید ایدهٔ خوبی باشد که بازخورد بخواهی.

expressions.example: That's good advice. I'll try it.
Thanks for the suggestion. I'll think about it.
expressions.examplePersian: ممنون از پیشنهادت. دربارهٔ آن فکر می‌کنم.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence gives advice in a friendly way?
options: If I were you, I'd talk to your manager first.
You must talk to your manager.
Talk to your manager, it is order.
exercises.explanation: If I were you, I'd + base verb
exercises.explanationPersian: If I were you, I'd + فعل ساده

exercises.prompt: A friend gives you advice and you do not want to decide yet. You say:
options: Thanks for the suggestion. I'll think about it.
exercises.explanation: I'll think about it is polite.
exercises.explanationPersian: I'll think about it مؤدبانه است.

acceptedAnswers: to
exercises.explanation: My goal is to + base verb
exercises.explanationPersian: My goal is to + فعل ساده

exercises.after: you, I'd talk to your manager first.
acceptedAnswers: were

commonErrors.feedback: In advice we use 'were': If I were you …
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: در توصیه were به کار می‌رود: If I were you …

acceptedAnswers: starting
exercises.explanationPersian: بعد از recommend شکل -ing می‌آید: I'd recommend starting …

speakingTask.instruction: Say one goal and why it matters, then give a friend advice.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: یک هدف و دلیلش را بگو، بعد به یک دوست توصیه بده.
modelSentences: My goal is to pass the IELTS exam this year.
I've been trying to learn ten new words every day.
If I were you, I'd join a conversation club.
You should practise a little every day.

roleplay.objective: Talk about a goal, receive advice and give your own advice back
roleplay.context: A friend wants to improve their English and asks about your experience. Say what you are working on, then give them advice in at least two different ways, and respond when they ask you for advice.
roleplay.opening: I want to improve my English quickly. Do you have any advice?
